knowledge:
- key_parameters: exprsMat_train=Log-transformed, size-factor normalized matrix of the reference dataset where rows are genes and columns are cells ;; cellTypes_train=Vector of cell type annotations for the training dataset ;; exprsMat_test=Log-transformed, size-factor normalized matrix or list of matrices for the query dataset(s) ;; cellTypes_test=Optional vector or list of vectors of cell type annotations for the query dataset(s) to calculate accuracy (set to NULL if unknown) ;; tree=Method to construct the cell type hierarchy (e.g., "HOPACH") ;; algorithm=Classification algorithm to use (e.g., "WKNN") ;; selectFeatures/features=Gene selection method(s) (e.g., "limma", "BI") ;; similarity=Similarity calculation metrics (e.g., "pearson", "spearman", "cosine") ;; weighted_ensemble=Logical indicating whether to weight base classifiers by their training accuracy (default is TRUE) ;; prob_threshold=Probability threshold for cell type assignment (default is 0.7) ;; returnList=Logical indicating whether to return results as a list
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when you have a well-annotated reference single-cell RNA-seq dataset and want to classify cell types in a query single-cell RNA-seq dataset, leveraging ensemble learning and hierarchical relationships.
- pitfalls: Input matrices must be log-transformed and size-factor normalized. If cellTypes_test is unknown, it must be set to NULL to avoid errors.

workflows.name: joint_scclassify
workflows.intent: Perform joint training and cell type prediction on a query dataset using a reference dataset in a single step.
input: reference_expression.csv (log-normalized expression matrix of reference cells)
reference_labels.csv (cell type annotations for reference cells)
query_expression.csv (log-normalized expression matrix of query cells)
workflows.stages: 1. Load and format reference and query expression matrices as sparse matrices (dgCMatrix) ;; 2. Run joint classification using scClassify() ;; 3. Inspect the trained cell type tree and prediction results.
workflows.code:
library("scClassify")
data("scClassify_example")
xin_cellTypes <- scClassify_example$xin_cellTypes
exprsMat_xin_subset <- scClassify_example$exprsMat_xin_subset
wang_cellTypes <- scClassify_example$wang_cellTypes
exprsMat_wang_subset <- scClassify_example$exprsMat_wang_subset
exprsMat_xin_subset <- as(exprsMat_xin_subset, "dgCMatrix")
exprsMat_wang_subset <- as(exprsMat_wang_subset, "dgCMatrix")
scClassify_res <- scClassify(exprsMat_train = exprsMat_xin_subset,
                             cellTypes_train = xin_cellTypes,
                             exprsMat_test = list(wang = exprsMat_wang_subset),
                             cellTypes_test = list(wang = wang_cellTypes),
                             tree = "HOPACH",
                             algorithm = "WKNN",
                             selectFeatures = c("limma"),
                             similarity = c("pearson"),
                             returnList = FALSE,
                             verbose = FALSE)
scClassify_res$trainRes
plotCellTypeTree(cellTypeTree(scClassify_res$trainRes))
table(scClassify_res$testRes$wang$pearson_WKNN_limma$predRes, wang_cellTypes)

workflows.name: predict_pretrained
workflows.intent: Predict cell types in a query dataset using an existing pretrained scClassify model.
input: query_expression.csv (log-normalized expression matrix of query cells)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the pretrained model and query expression matrix ;; 2. Format the query matrix as a sparse matrix (dgCMatrix) ;; 3. Run prediction using predict_scClassify() ;; 4. Inspect prediction results.
workflows.code:
library(scClassify)
data("scClassify_example")
wang_cellTypes <- scClassify_example$wang_cellTypes
exprsMat_wang_subset <- scClassify_example$exprsMat_wang_subset
exprsMat_wang_subset <- as(exprsMat_wang_subset, "dgCMatrix")
data("trainClassExample_xin")
features(trainClassExample_xin)
plotCellTypeTree(cellTypeTree(trainClassExample_xin))
pred_res <- predict_scClassify(exprsMat_test = exprsMat_wang_subset,
                               trainRes = trainClassExample_xin,
                               cellTypes_test = wang_cellTypes,
                               algorithm = "WKNN",
                               features = c("limma"),
                               similarity = c("pearson", "spearman"),
                               prob_threshold = 0.7,
                               verbose = TRUE)
table(pred_res$pearson_WKNN_limma$predRes, wang_cellTypes)

workflows.name: train_custom_model
workflows.intent: Train and save a custom scClassifyTrainModel on a reference dataset for future predictions.
input: reference_expression.csv (log-normalized expression matrix of reference cells)
reference_labels.csv (cell type annotations for reference cells)
workflows.stages: 1. Load and format reference expression matrix as a sparse matrix (dgCMatrix) ;; 2. Train the model using train_scClassify() with selected feature selection methods.
workflows.code:
library("scClassify")
data("scClassify_example")
xin_cellTypes <- scClassify_example$xin_cellTypes
exprsMat_xin_subset <- scClassify_example$exprsMat_xin_subset
exprsMat_xin_subset <- as(exprsMat_xin_subset, "dgCMatrix")
trainClass <- train_scClassify(exprsMat_train = exprsMat_xin_subset,
                               cellTypes_train = xin_cellTypes,
                               selectFeatures = c("limma", "BI"),
                               returnList = FALSE
)
trainClass
